subject.title: fix: confine artifact redirects to their origin

question: Should Crabbox make same-origin redirects the default fail-closed contract for artifact manifest fetches, artifact downloads, and brokered uploads, accepting that cross-origin redirecting storage aliases will stop working?
rationale: This changes the credential-bearing artifact transfer security boundary and can break deployments that currently depend on cross-origin storage or CDN redirects, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Land same-origin fail-closed policy
options.body: Accept this PR's same-origin contract after proof and changelog cleanup because it matches Crabbox's documented credential-destination principle and fixes the linked reports.

options.title: Disable artifact redirects entirely
options.body: Ask for a stricter patch that refuses every redirect for credential-bearing artifact transfers, trading compatibility for a simpler security rule.

options.title: Require an explicit compatibility path
options.body: Pause the PR and design an opt-in or migration path for trusted cross-origin artifact aliases before changing default behavior.

recommendation.title: Land same-origin fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Accept this PR's same-origin contract after proof and changelog cleanup because it matches Crabbox's documented credential-destination principle and fixes the linked reports.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest artifact publishing and coordinator redirect feature-history signal for the policy choice.
